source_title: A War Without Purpose Becomes Imperial Suicide

chronology_notes.note: This 2026-03-09 interview sits after the March 3 attrition/aura source and before the March 20 no-exit Tucker source; it gives the fuller bridge from failed nuclear pretext and Hormuz shock to Gulf mirage fragility, petrodollar dependency, and regional/global escalation.
The source explicitly sequences the future into immediate Gulf devastation, Iranian recovery through Hormuz leverage, mid-term Pax Judaica, and eventual Iran-Israel/global eschatological conflict.
The source gives a March 9 forecast that Trump would visit Beijing on March 31, 2026 and that U.S.-China relations would thaw temporarily in 2026 even though the larger global order was dying.

The closing statement records Jiang's retrospective claim that he had been predicting a U.S. invasion of Iran consistently for roughly two years before the March 2026 crisis, but that the event still shocked him when it happened.
